# Ezekiel 4 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 4:8 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-behold, I-have-put upon-you ropes, and-you-shall-not-turn from-your-side to-your-[other]-side until you-complete the-days-of your-siege. |
| LOGOS | And behold, I will place cords upon you, so that you cannot turn from one side to the other, till you have completed the days of your siege. |
| PNEUMA | I will tie you up with ropes so you can't turn from one side to the other until the days of your siege are finished. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 4:10 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-your-food which you-eat [shall be] by-weight — twenty shekels per-day; from-time to-time you-shall-eat-it. |
| LOGOS | And your food that you eat shall be by weight, twenty shekels a day; from day to day you shall eat it. |
| PNEUMA | You are allowed only eight ounces of food per day, and you may eat only at set times. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 4:11 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-water by-measure you-shall-drink — a-sixth-of a-hin; from-time to-time you-shall-drink. |
| LOGOS | And water you shall drink by measure, the sixth part of a hin; from day to day you shall drink. |
| PNEUMA | You may drink only two-thirds of a quart of water per day, at set times. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 4:15 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-He-said to-me, "See, I-have-given to-you [the]-dung-of cattle in-place-of [the]-dung-of man, and-you-shall-make your-bread upon-it." |
| LOGOS | Then He said to me, "See, I will let you have cow's dung instead of human dung, on which you may prepare your bread." |
| PNEUMA | "All right," He said. "I will let you use cow dung instead of human dung for baking your bread." |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 4:17 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | so-that they-lack bread and-water, and-they-shall-be-appalled each-one and-his-brother, and-they-shall-waste-away in-their-iniquity. |
| LOGOS | I will do this that they may lack bread and water, and look at one another in dismay, and waste away under their punishment. |
| PNEUMA | Food and water will run out. They will stare at each other in horror and slowly waste away because of their sins. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 4:16 (overlap: 4%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-He-said to-me, "Son-of man, behold-Me breaking [the]-staff-of bread in-Jerusalem, and-they-shall-eat bread by-weight and-in-anxiety, and-water by-measure and-in-horror they-shall-drink, |
| LOGOS | Moreover, He said to me, "Son of man, behold, I will break the supply of bread in Jerusalem. They shall eat bread by weight and with anxiety, and they shall drink water by measure and in dismay. |
| PNEUMA | Then He said, "Son of man, I am going to cut off the food supply in Jerusalem. The people will ration their food with fear and measure their water with dread. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.
